code: library(harnessr) old <- hr_options(verbose = FALSE, embedder = "lexical") op <- options(digits = 3) # Illustrative prices for a stand-in model. For a real model, use your # provider's current prices. hr_register_model("mock-model", context_window = 128000, max_output = 16384,                   input_usd = 1, output_usd = 4) co <- data.frame(   place   = c("Ashford", "Bexley", "Carlow", "Dunmore", "Elstow", "Fenwick",               "Garston", "Hollins", "Irvine", "Jarrow", "Kelso", "Larne"),   revenue = c(45.2, 51.8, 38.9, 29.4, 61.3, 33.7, 48.5, 27.1, 55.6, 40.2, 36.4, 52.9),   units   = c(12400, 9800, 15100, 7600, 11200, 8300, 13900, 6900, 10500, 14700, 9100, 12800),   staff   = c(310, 275, 402, 198, 356, 221, 389, 167, 298, 344, 251, 377),   exports = c(7, 12, 4, 9, 15, 6, 11, 3, 8, 14, 5, 10))  report <- function(r) paste(c(   sprintf("%s annual report", r$place),   sprintf(paste("Results. Revenue was %.1f million dollars in fiscal 2024. Analysts expect",                 "revenue to reach %.1f million dollars by 2026 if prices hold. Export",                 "revenue rose with prices."), r$revenue, round(r$revenue * 1.2, 1)),   sprintf(paste("Operations. The plant in %s made %s units. Output was limited by a two week",                 "shutdown for repairs. A second line is planned for next year."),           r$place, format(r$units, big.mark = ",")),   sprintf(paste("People. Staff numbered %d at year end. Training hours per person doubled.",                 "Turnover fell for the third year."), r$staff),   sprintf(paste("Trade. Exports rose %d percent. Most shipments went by sea. Units shipped",                 "abroad by the plant are counted separately."), r$exports),   paste("Governance. The audit committee met four times. Staff representatives joined",         "the board at year end.")),   collapse = "\n\n") docs <- setNames(vapply(seq_len(nrow(co)), function(i) report(co[i, ]), ""), co$place)  qs <- c(revenue = "What was revenue in fiscal 2024?",         units   = "How many units did the plant make?",         staff   = "How many staff were there at year end?",         exports = "By how much did exports rise?") grid_q <- expand.grid(topic = names(qs), place = co$place, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) answer_of <- function(place, topic) {   r <- co[co$place == place, ]   switch(topic, revenue = sprintf("%.1f million", r$revenue),          units = format(r$units, big.mark = ","), staff = as.character(r$staff),          exports = sprintf("%d percent", r$exports)) } qa <- gr_qa_reference(   questions = setNames(unname(qs[grid_q$topic]), paste(grid_q$place, grid_q$topic, sep = "_")),   documents = unname(docs[grid_q$place]),   answers   = unname(Map(answer_of, grid_q$place, grid_q$topic)),   cluster   = grid_q$place,   split     = ifelse(grid_q$place %in% co$place[1:4], "dev", "test")) qa #> <hr_reference> 48 item(s) in 12 cluster(s) #>   splits: dev 16, test 32  #>   hash: c3a742404b80 pattern <- c(revenue = "Revenue was [0-9.]+ million dollars in fiscal 2024",              units = "made [0-9,]+ units", staff = "Staff numbered [0-9]+",              exports = "Exports rose [0-9]+ percent") reader <- hr_mock_client(function(messages, params) {   seen <- paste(vapply(messages, function(m) as.character(m$content), ""), collapse = " ")   asked <- sub(".*Question", "", seen)   topic <- names(pattern)[vapply(c("revenue", "units", "staff", "exports"), grepl,                                  logical(1), x = asked, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]   hit <- regmatches(seen, regexpr(pattern[[topic]], seen))   if (!length(hit)) return("NOT_IN_DOCUMENT")   if (runif(1) < nchar(seen) / 6000) return("The report does not say clearly.")   paste0(hit, ".") })

code: seg_grid <- expand.grid(method = c("fixed", "sentence", "paragraph"),                         max_tokens = c(40, 80), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) seg_grid$name <- paste(seg_grid$method, seg_grid$max_tokens, sep = "_") dev_docs <- docs[co$place[1:4]]  boundary_error <- function(method, max_tokens) {   per_doc <- vapply(dev_docs, function(d) {     ref <- gr_seg_boundaries(strsplit(d, "\n\n")[[1]], d)     hyp <- gr_seg_boundaries(gr_segment(d, list(method = method, max_tokens = max_tokens)), d)     c(pk = gr_seg_pk(ref, hyp), windowdiff = gr_seg_windowdiff(ref, hyp))   }, numeric(2))   round(rowMeans(per_doc), 3) } cbind(seg_grid["name"], t(mapply(boundary_error, seg_grid$method, seg_grid$max_tokens))) #>                     name    pk windowdiff #> fixed           fixed_40 0.444      0.444 #> sentence     sentence_40 0.722      0.722 #> paragraph   paragraph_40 0.194      0.222 #> fixed.1         fixed_80 0.500      0.500 #> sentence.1   sentence_80 0.556      0.556 #> paragraph.1 paragraph_80 0.278      0.278

rscript <- file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript") work <- file.path(tempdir(), "coding-loop") dir.create(work, showWarnings = FALSE) tests <- file.path(work, "test-clamp.R") writeLines(c("stopifnot(clamp(5, 0, 3) == 3)", "stopifnot(clamp(2, 0, 3) == 2)"), tests) coder <- hr_mock_client(function(messages, params) {   text <- messages[[length(messages)]]$content   if (grepl("failed its tests", text, fixed = TRUE)) {     "clamp <- function(x, lo, hi) max(lo, min(x, hi))"   } else {     "clamp <- function(x, lo, hi) max(lo, max(x, hi))"   } }) draft <- hr_step("draft", function(item, ctx) {   code <- tempfile("clamp-", tmpdir = work, fileext = ".R")   writeLines(ctx$call(item$task)$text, code)   list(code = code) }) run_tests <- function(input, ctx) {   c(rscript, "-e", sprintf("source('%s'); source('%s')",                            gsub("\\", "/", input$code), gsub("\\", "/", tests))) } revise <- hr_step("revise", function(input, ctx) {   if (identical(input$check$status, "passed")) return(input)   fixed <- ctx$call(paste0("This code failed its tests:
",                            paste(readLines(input$code), collapse = "
"),                            "
What the tests printed:
", input$check$stderr))$text   writeLines(fixed, input$code)   input }) coding <- hr_chain(draft = draft,                    check = hr_step_command("check", run_tests),                    revise = revise,                    held = hr_step_command("held", run_tests, held = TRUE),                    name = "coding") first <- hr_chain(coding, check = NULL, revise = NULL, name = "first-draft") held_passes <- hr_scorer(function(item, output, label) {   s <- attr(output, "hr_held")$held$status   list(correct = identical(s, label), outcome = s, failure_kind = NA) }, name = "held_passes") tasks <- hr_reference(list(clamp = list(task = "Write clamp(x, lo, hi) in R.")),                       labels = "passed", cluster = "clamp", split = "test") cb <- hr_benchmark(list(coding, first), tasks, runs = 5, client = coder,                    scorer = held_passes) table(cb$arm, cb$outcome) #>               #>               failed passed #>   coding           0      5 #>   first-draft      5      0 hr_signals(cb, "command.held")[1:2, c("arm", "run", "value")] #>      arm run  value #> 1 coding   1 passed #> 2 coding   2 passed unlink(work, recursive = TRUE)

Test is_not_found()-style matching rather substring search. premise Present read spec checked question's premise (premise = TRUE gr_read_spec()). NA model reported nothing document contradicting question; otherwise sentence said document states instead, answer well, is_not_found() FALSE. model's verdict, check harnessr made. Absent (NULL) spec ask, screen extract, answer question. outcome Character(1), set gr_read(): "answered", answer marked partial; "partial", answer marked partial; "not_found", NOT_IN_DOCUMENT run read meant ; "refused", NOT_IN_DOCUMENT run limit stopped; "failed", NOT_IN_DOCUMENT run got reply read (every model request made failed, notes give error), whichever reader made . is_not_found() reads given answer. answer_format = "schema" gr_read_spec() model reports answered -found part schema field, notes$structured keeps said. premise_verdict Present premise = TRUE premise_verdict = "structured" gr_read_spec(), readers whose answering request structured: list premise_status ("holds" "contradicted"), quote (passage model gave contradiction, NA) quote_verified (whether quote found excerpts sent, check gr_verify_evidence() uses, , passages summaries model wrote, document ; NA without quote). partial Logical(1). TRUE anything degraded: call failed, chunks dropped, cap hit, strategy fell back, text cut fit, pages document never became text (scan read without OCR). Check trusting answer. notes List. partial, per-reader detail: dropped_chunks, failed_calls, error, merge_levels, degraded_to_bm25, stop_reason, call_cap_reached, cost_cap_reached, summaries_truncated, . Three can set every reader: cited_unknown, chunk ids answer cited never sent; unverified_evidence, number quoted spans chunk claim come ; unread_pages, pages never became text. makes answer partial. warnings Character. harnessr warned document ingested, cut read, named warning's class. warnings still print happen; copy stays answer, including document came ingestion cache nothing raised . evidence Data frame NULL, columns chunk_id, text, page, section, score, kind. text holds depends reader: verbatim chunk text stuff, retrieve, rerank iterative; model-extracted passages skim; per-chunk model answers map_reduce. refine hierarchical return NULL. page populated PDF sources; score retrieve (cosine) rerank (0-10, model-judged). evidence model-written (skim), three columns appear: source_text, chunk span claims quote, plus verified match checking one ; see gr_verify_evidence(). Readers whose evidence verbatim chunk text carry , span source string. kind says row holds ("verbatim", "extracted" "answer") per row, ensemble mixes . blank roxygen line inside \describe{} item ends item, one paragraph. chunks_used Integer vector chunk_ids CONTRIBUTED answer. per-chunk readers subset chunks sent: chunk answered NOT_IN_DOCUMENT read paid listed. notes$chunks reports many sent. reader, signature strategy ran, traversal signature (see gr_reader_signature()). question question, asked. trace gr_trace (see hr_trace()) run. answer_document() holds whole run: ingestion, segmentation read. answer taken gr_compare() holds recipe's segmentation read (segmentation requests, semantic, proposition contextual context_source = "llm" bill, pre-flight check reader's requests), recipe counted apart. code: # A simulated graded set: 40 documents, 10 questions each, a quarter of # them unanswerable, and a signal that is informative but overconfident. set.seed(1) n <- 400 answerable <- rep(c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE), length.out = n) truth <- stats::runif(n, 0.2, 0.95) * answerable graded <- data.frame(   cluster = rep(sprintf("doc%02d", 1:40), each = 10),   score = pmin(1, truth + 0.15),   correct = stats::runif(n) < truth,   answerable = answerable) key <- list(served_model = "mock-model-2026-01-01", version = "2026-01-01",             task = "qa", format = "pdf", prompt_hash = "a1b2c3", effort = "low",             module = "iterative") cal <- hr_calibrate_signal("gr.iterative.can_answer", graded, key, seed = 7, B = 200) cal #> <hr_calibration> gr.iterative.can_answer: advisory #>   400 items (235 wrong, 100 unanswerable) in 40 clusters; map: platt #>   key: served_model=mock-model-2026-01-01, version=2026-01-01, task=qa, format=pdf, prompt_hash=a1b2c3, effort=low, module=iterative, contract_version=0.1 #>   calibration half: 200 items, accuracy 0.410 #>   brier   0.1598  [0.1305, 0.1920] #>   auroc2  0.8393  [0.7791, 0.8918] #>   aurc    0.3514  [0.2717, 0.4426] #>   ece     0.0552  [0.0000, 0.1964] #>   advisory: no gate threshold has been set  # The same split with no map shows what Platt scaling bought. raw <- hr_calibrate_signal("gr.iterative.can_answer", graded, key, method = "none",                            seed = 7, B = 0) raw$metrics[raw$metrics$metric %in% c("brier", "ece"), ] #>   metric  estimate lower upper #> 1  brier 0.1843548    NA    NA #> 4    ece 0.1690354    NA    NA

Widen the margin, enlarge the design, or register the contrast with confirmatory = FALSE as exploratory.

code: ref <- hr_reference(sprintf("q%02d", 1:40), labels = rep("yes", 40),                     cluster = sprintf("c%02d", rep(1:20, each = 2)), split = "test") arm_at <- function(name, effort) {   hr_arm(name, function(item, ctx) {     tr <- ctx$trace     a <- hr_call(ctx$client, paste("first", item), model = "gpt-5.6-luna", trace = tr,                  label = "task.draft", effort = effort)     b <- hr_call(ctx$client, paste("final", item), model = "gpt-5.6-luna", trace = tr,                  label = "task.final", effort = effort)     b$text   }) } # Four hard items: the first step finds nothing at low effort, and the # answer is wrong unless the final step reasons at high effort. cl <- hr_mock_client(function(m, p) {   hard <- grepl("q0[1-4]", m[[1]]$content)   if (grepl("first", m[[1]]$content) && hard) return("NOT_IN_DOCUMENT")   if (hard && identical(p$effort, "low")) "no" else "yes" }) esc <- hr_effort_escalate(replies = c(not_in_document = "NOT_IN_DOCUMENT")) arms <- list(arm_at("low", "low"), arm_at("high", "high"), arm_at("escalate", esc)) bench <- hr_benchmark(arms, ref, runs = 5, client = cl,                       governor = hr_governor(max_calls = 2000, max_cost_usd = 5)) chk <- hr_effort_check(bench, "escalate", margin = 0.1, cost_test = FALSE, B = 200) chk #> <hr_effort_check> escalate against low, high (post hoc: no registration) #>   vs low          margin 10.0 pts, difference +10.0 pts, lower bound -6.7: non-inferior #>   vs high         margin 10.0 pts, difference +0.0 pts, lower bound -9.9: non-inferior #>   best fixed comparator: high #>       arm accuracy usd calls escalations escalated_calls resolved priced as_of #>       low      0.9  NA     2         0.0             0.0       NA  FALSE  <NA> #>      high      1.0  NA     2         0.0             0.0       NA  FALSE  <NA> #>  escalate      1.0  NA     2         0.1             0.1        1  FALSE  <NA> #>  certain #>     TRUE #>     TRUE #>     TRUE #>   usd is NA for low, high, escalate: no price set for a model of those arms (set one with hr_register_model() or hr_load_models())

code: rscript <- file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript") check <- hr_step_command("check", c(rscript, "-e", "quit(status = 0)")) check(list(draft = "x"), list())$check$status #> [1] "passed"  # The command can depend on the step's input. f <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines("stopifnot(1 + 1 == 2)", f) run_file <- hr_step_command("run", function(input, ctx) c(rscript, input$file)) run_file(list(file = f), list())$check$status #> [1] "passed"  # Held back from later steps, for the scorer. ref <- hr_reference(list(q1 = "f"), labels = "passed", cluster = "a", split = "test") chain <- hr_chain(   draft = hr_step("draft", function(input, ctx) list(item = input)),   check = hr_step_command("check", c(rscript, "-e", "quit(status = 1)"),                           held = TRUE),   name = "held") passes <- hr_scorer(function(item, output, label) {   s <- attr(output, "hr_held")$check$status   list(correct = identical(s, label), outcome = s, failure_kind = NA) }, name = "passes") bench <- hr_benchmark(chain, ref, runs = 5, client = NULL, scorer = passes) table(bench$outcome) #>  #> failed  #>      5  unlink(f)
